plain: A writer and historian named Peter Levenda says, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, that Sybil Leek, a famous witch and astrologer, was openly involved with Operation Often. That was said to be the occult side of MK-Ultra, a secret CIA program of mind-control research that ran from the 1950s into the 1970s. If true, it would mean US intelligence was taking magic and the paranormal seriously.
